n: Front Load Washer with Extra Power and 16-Hr Fresh Hold® option - 4.8 cu. ft.
desc: Get the heavy duty washing machine that delivers powerful cleaning you can depend on backed by the Extra Power button that boosts stain-fighting performance on any wash cycle with a dual-temperature wash. With the push of a button, Maytag fights stains that dissolve best in hot water and in cold—all in a single load.
hl: The Extra Power button boosts stain fighting on any wash cycle with an intense pre-wash and extra agitation so you can walk away while stains wash away.

The stainless steel wash basket is designed for years of washes and built with sturdy materials to last for the long haul.
